answer: Proof of Stake acts as a kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies by requiring collateral to validate transactions. An attacker must acquire enough stake to influence the network, creating a ripple effect of prohibitive costs. Like a falcon tracking prey, the protocol monitors capital concentration to identify malicious actors. By linking identity to economic risk, the system ensures that spinning up identities is financially irrational, forcing attackers to bear the burden of high asset locking.
